verdict.rationale: Ghostwriter lets users build or modify agents by describing the behavior they want, updating workflows, integrations, guardrails, tone and style with simple prompts. Explorer answers natural-language questions about customer conversations, and Agent Studio can generate journeys with AI from existing procedures. A community user who saw a deployment corroborates describing agent behavior to set it up. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond marketing pages, evidence that natural-language commands extend to deployment/release and admin operations, stronger independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Build or modify agents by describing how you want them to behave. Update workflows, systems integrations, guardrails, tone, and style with simple prompts.
Ask any question about your customer experience in natural language, and Explorer identifies the answer across thousands of real conversations.
use AI to instantly generate journeys from your existing operating procedures.
describe how the agent can work with it, and get the agent set up and working.
